Click here follow the step-by-step instructions to verify and fund your account to start trading. Opening a live account allows you to begin trading immediately. We recommend clients to read through our Risk Disclosures, Privacy Policy and Terms of Business before they start trading.

chunk.heading: How can I deposit funds into my account?
chunk.text:
How can I deposit funds into my account?
You may log in to your member area and select the preferred payment option and deposit size.

chunk.heading: I have not received my funds after my withdrawal request. What should I do?
chunk.text:
I have not received my funds after my withdrawal request. What should I do?
Should you not receive your funds within 24 hours, please reach out to our friendly support team for assistance.

chunk.heading: How to Verify Account: steps
chunk.text:
How to Verify Account

Identity verification plays a crucial role in ensuring the utmost security and protection against identity theft and fraud

Steps

1. Complete the required fields and upload the required documents to complete your KYC profile
2. Once completed, you will be taken to this page while your account is being reviewed
3. Account verification completed! You’re all set to trade

chunk.heading: How long does it take to open an account?
chunk.text:
How long does it take to open an account?
Account opening and document verification will be completed within 48 hours.

chunk.heading: How can I deposit funds into my account?

How can I deposit funds into my account?
You may log in to your member area and select the preferred payment option and deposit size.

chunk.heading: Why was my withdrawal request rejected?
chunk.text:
Why was my withdrawal request rejected?
It could be that your account has not been verified, a possible error to data entered or insifficient margin to process withdrawals. We will notify you via email on the rejection reason to help fix this issue.

chunk.heading: Where can I view my deposit and withdrawal history?
chunk.text:
Where can I view my deposit and withdrawal history?
You may log in to your member area to view all transactions related to deposits, withdrawals and transfers.

chunk.heading: Do you offer an Islamic-friendly account?
chunk.text:
Do you offer an Islamic-friendly account?
All our account are Islamic friendly and there is no swap is credited or withdrawn from all trading account.

chunk.heading: What is the minimum initial deposit needed to open an account?
chunk.text:
What is the minimum initial deposit needed to open an account?
It will depend on the account type that is being selected. You may view details of all our accounts here and the minimum deposit that is required for each account type.

chunk.heading: How long does it take to open an account?
chunk.text:
How long does it take to open an account?
Account opening and document verification will be completed within 48 hours.

chunk.heading: What account type should I open?
chunk.text:
What account type should I open?
It will depend on your trading strategy and preferred trading instruments. You may view the various account types here. You may open another account type that suits you better at a later stage too.
